rules.name: Bahis ve casino
rules.details: Bahis, casino ve "deneme bonusu" reklamları.

en.name: Betting and casino
en.details: Betting, casino and "free trial bonus" ads.

rules.note: Betting spam avoids "bonus" with wording like "deneme hediye" or "yatirim sartsiz anlik cekim". A bare "%10 bonus" is left out: it is also how Garanti BBVA Bonus card campaigns read. Free spins come as "25Spn"; a bare "spin" or "FS" needs "hediye" or "bedava" next to it. Sites rotate numbered domains (betvakti414.com, vaycasino1042.com) and write "B0nus" or "cevirmsiz". "Her gole hediye" is left out: carriers run match campaigns like that too.
rules.pattern: \b(bahis|\w*casino\w*|kumarhane|rulet|freespin\w*|free spin\w*|freebet|b0nus\w*|deneme (bonus\w*|hediye\w*)|yatirim bonusu|kayip bonusu|hos ?geldin bonusu|cevi?ri?msiz\w*|cevrim ?sartsiz|yatirim ?sartsiz|sartsiz (bonus|hediye|cekim)\w*|anlik cekim|canli bahis|bedava bahis|\d+ ?spn|\d+ ?(spin|fs) (hediye|bedava)\w*|hediye\w* \d+ ?fs|[a-z]*(bet|bahis)[a-z]*\d+(\.({{linkTLDs}})|com)(?![a-z0-9-]))\b

rules.name: Kredi ve borç kapatma
rules.details: "Borcunuzu kapatıyoruz", "sicil affı", "kefilsiz kredi" gibi kredi teklifleri.

en.name: Loans and debt payoff
en.details: Loan offers like "we'll pay off your debt", "credit record amnesty" or "loans without a guarantor".

rules.note: "Nakit ihtiyac" and "aninda kredi" are left out: banks advertise with them. A message with opt-out info (optOut) is left to Promotions.
rules.pattern: (kredi notu(nuz)? (ne olursa olsun|fark etmez|onemsiz|dusuk)|borc\w* kapatiyoruz|borc kapatma kredi\w*|icrali\w* (kredi|kisi)|kefilsiz kredi|sicil affi)

rules.name: Sahte ödül ve çekiliş
rules.details: "Tebrikler, kazandınız", "hediyeniz tanımlandı" gibi sahte ödüller.

en.name: Fake prizes and draws
en.details: Fake prizes like "Congratulations, you've won" or "your gift is ready".

rules.note: "Hak kazandiniz" is left out: bank draws say "cekilise katilmaya hak kazandiniz". A message with opt-out info (optOut) is left to Promotions.

rules.name: Kısaltılmış linkler
rules.details: bit.ly, cutt.ly gibi asıl adresi gizleyen kısa linkler.

en.name: Shortened links
en.details: Short links like bit.ly or cutt.ly that hide the real address.

rules.note: Brands send short links in campaigns too, so a message with opt-out info (optOut) is left to Promotions.

rules.name: Telegram linkleri
rules.details: t.me linkleri. Takip ettiğin bir kanal SMS ile link atıyorsa kapat.

en.name: Telegram links
en.details: t.me links. Turn this off if a channel you follow sends links by SMS.

rules.note: Betting and scam groups move people to Telegram; banks, carriers and shops rarely link there by SMS. A separate rule so it can be turned off for a Telegram channel you follow.

rules.name: Sahte kargo, ceza ve iade linkleri
rules.details: Gümrük ücreti, HGS/OGS cezası veya vergi iadesini .tr olmayan bir linkle isteyen mesajlar.

en.name: Fake delivery, fine and refund links
en.details: Messages asking for a customs fee, HGS/OGS toll fine or tax refund through a link that isn't .tr.

rules.note: Asks for a payment or refund through a link. "Teslim edilemedi" and "adres eksik" are left out: real carriers send those with a tracking link (yurticikargo.com) too.

rules.name: Resmi kurum taklidi linkler
rules.details: e-Devlet'i taklit eden adresler. Gerçek adres yalnızca turkiye.gov.tr.

en.name: Government lookalike links
en.details: Addresses imitating e-Devlet. The real address is only turkiye.gov.tr.

rules.note: The only real e-Devlet domain is turkiye.gov.tr. "gov.tr-..." / "gov.tr.xyz" and "edevlet", "turkiye-gov" inside another domain are look-alikes.

rules.name: Şüpheli alan adı uzantıları
rules.details: .xyz, .top, .icu gibi bankaların ve mağazaların kullanmadığı uzantılar.

en.name: Suspicious domain endings
en.details: Endings like .xyz, .top or .icu that banks and stores don't use.

rules.note: Cheap TLDs that real Turkish banks, carriers and shops don't use. Many of them are also words, so "Ödemeniz alındı.Online işlemler" (a missing space) must not count: a word-like TLD needs a link sign (http, www, a path) or a hyphen/digit in the domain. "www." only starts a link where no domain is in progress and the part before the first digit or hyphen is letters only: otherwise the regex engine retries every position and 20,000 characters of "www." or "a1" took seconds.

rules.name: Ücretsiz hosting ve IP linkleri
rules.details: Ücretsiz site servislerinde (netlify, blogspot...) veya IP adresinde açılan linkler.

en.name: Free hosting and IP links
en.details: Links on free website services (netlify, blogspot...) or to an IP address.

rules.name: Marka taklidi alan adları
rules.details: turkcell-odeme.com gibi marka adına kelime eklenmiş taklit adresler.

en.name: Brand lookalike domains
en.details: Fake addresses that add a word to a brand name, like turkcell-odeme.com.

rules.note: Hyphenated .com/.net/.org domains with words like "odeme", "dogrulama" or a "-tr" part, e.g. turkcell-odeme.com. Real brands use their plain domain (turkcell.com.tr).

rules.name: Telefon numarasından marka taklidi
rules.details: Bir telefon numarasından gelen, bir banka, operatör ya da kargo firmasının adını kullanıp o firmanın kendi adresi olmayan bir linke yönlendiren mesajlar (ör. "Akbank: hesabınız bloke, akbank-guvenli.com"). Firmaların kendi mesajları kayıtlı adla gelir.

en.name: Brand impersonation from phone numbers
en.details: Messages from a phone number that use a bank, carrier or courier's name but point to a link that isn't that company's own address (e.g. "Akbank: your account is blocked, akbank-guvenli.com"). The companies' own messages come from their registered name.

rules.note: Each branch: a brand name, and a link that isn't one of the brand's own domains or .tr. Links without http/www count only with a TLD that isn't a word (bareTLDs), so a missing space ("alindi.Online") doesn't. "akbank.com.evil.xyz" and "gov.tr.evil.com" aren't the brand's or .tr (hostEnd). Only for phone numbers: the brands' own campaigns, from their registered names, link to partner stores ("VakifBank Worldcard'la hepsiburada.com'da").

rules.name: Link ile bilgi isteyen mesajlar
rules.details: Kart, kimlik veya giriş bilgisini .tr olmayan bir linkle isteyen mesajlar.

en.name: Messages asking for details via a link
en.details: Messages asking for card, ID or login details through a link that isn't .tr.

rules.note: Banks and institutions never ask for card, ID or login details through an SMS link to a non-.tr domain. Their own .tr sites (turkiye.gov.tr, garantibbva.com.tr) are left alone.
rules.pattern: ^(?=.*(kart bilgileri|kimlik bilgi|kimlik dogrulama|iban ve kimlik|tc kimlik numaraniz|bilgilerinizi (gir|guncelle|dogrula|onayla)|giris (yapin|bilgilerinizle)\b|adresinizi (bugun icinde )?(onaylayin|guncelleyin|dogrulayin)))(?=.*{{nonTurkishLink}})

rules.name: Telefon numarasından kargo veya banka linki
rules.details: Bir telefon numarasından gelen, kargo ya da banka diliyle yazılmış ve tanınmayan bir linke yönlendiren mesajlar. Gerçek kargo firmaları ve bankalar kayıtlı bir adla (ör. ARAS KARGO) yazar.

en.name: Courier or bank links from phone numbers
en.details: Messages from a phone number that use courier or bank wording and point to an unknown link. Real couriers and banks send from a registered name like ARAS KARGO.

rules.note: Companies must send SMS from a registered sender name in Turkey; fake courier and bank messages come from mobile or foreign numbers. "Gonderin" (send) isn't "gonderi" (shipment). Needs a real link (http or www) so a missing space ("verdim.yarin") doesn't count, and leaves .tr links and couriers' own domains (a seller forwarding a tracking link) alone. App versions without senderPattern would apply this to every sender; they reject this list because it junks the Hepsiburada legitimate sample (see RuleCatalogTests), so keep hepsiburada.com out of courierDomains.

rules.name: Sahte kart, fatura veya kargo bildirimi
rules.details: Kart harcaması, fatura ya da kargo bildirimi gibi görünüp tanınmayan bir linke tıklatan veya bir şey almak için önce ücret yatırtan mesajlar. Gerçek bildirimler bankanın, operatörün ya da kargo firmasının kendi sitesine yönlendirir.

en.name: Fake card, bill or delivery notices
en.details: Messages that look like a card charge, bill or delivery notice but have you click an unknown link, or ask for a fee before you get something. Real notices link to the bank's, carrier's or courier's own site.

rules.note: Without this, the Transactions rules (card-activity, bill, delivery-info) file these as notices when they come from a registered sender name. The click has to lead straight to the link ("iptal icin tiklayin: kart-iptal.com"), and .tr links and the domains in noticeDomains (the brands brand-link knows) are left alone, like the Aras sample's "Adres teyidi icin tiklayin: https://aras.la/...". Campaigns with opt-out info or a Mersis number ("almak istemiyorsaniz tiklayin http://izn.im/...") are left to the campaign rules.

rules.name: "Anne/baba ben" dolandırıcılığı
rules.details: "Anne ben, para gönder" mesajları. Ailen rehberde olduğu için etkilenmez.

en.name: "Mom/Dad, it's me" scam
en.details: "Mom, it's me, send money" messages. Your family is in your contacts, so they aren't affected.

rules.note: Family members are in Contacts, so iOS never sends their messages to the filter. "Abi/abla" are left out: they are also how strangers, like couriers, address you. A bare "gonder" is left out: "Anne ben yarin belge gondercem" is not about money.

rules.name: Yanlış havale dolandırıcılığı
rules.details: "Yanlışlıkla hesabınıza para gönderdim" dolandırıcılığı.

en.name: Wrong transfer scam
en.details: "I sent money to your account by mistake" scams.

rules.note: Spelling is loose on purpose: these messages often come with typos ("yanlşlıkla").

rules.name: Cep numarası aratan banka uyarısı
rules.details: "İşlem size ait değilse" deyip cep numarası aratan sahte banka uyarıları.

en.name: Bank alerts with a mobile number
en.details: Fake bank alerts that say "if you didn't make this transaction" and ask you to call a mobile number.

rules.note: Banks give 444 / 0850 lines, never a mobile number. The whole number is required, so "0850 222 0 500" or "4.550 TL" doesn't count as a 5xx mobile number ("x" allows masked digits).

rules.name: Kod paylaşma tuzağı
rules.details: Gelen doğrulama kodunu iletmeni isteyen mesajlar. Gerçek kodlar "kimseyle paylaşmayın" der.

en.name: Code sharing trap
en.details: Messages asking you to pass on a verification code you received. Real codes say "don't share it with anyone".

rules.note: Real OTP messages say "don't share this code"; scams ask you to pass it on. Only positive verb forms match: the first part lists them, the second rejects the negative "-me/-ma" ("iletmeyin"). Delivery codes meant for the courier are left out.

rules.name: Sahte iş ilanı
rules.details: "Ürün yorumu yaparak günlük 2.000 TL" gibi sahte iş ilanları.

en.name: Fake job offers
en.details: Fake job offers like "earn 2,000 TL a day reviewing products".

rules.name: Link içeren tüm mesajlar
rules.details: İçinde http veya www geçen her mesaj. Bankaların ve kargoların linkli mesajları da gider.

en.name: All messages with links
en.details: Every message containing http or www. Banks' and couriers' messages with links go too.

rules.name: 0850 numaraları
rules.details: 0850 ile başlayan numaralardan gelen tüm mesajlar.

en.name: 0850 numbers
en.details: All messages from numbers starting with 0850.

rules.name: Ticari SMS (İYS / RET)
rules.details: İYS veya RET bilgisi taşıyan ticari kampanya mesajları.

en.name: Commercial SMS (İYS / RET)
en.details: Marketing messages carrying İYS or RET opt-out information.

rules.note: Registered senders must say how to opt out; none of the spam in a real Messages junk folder did, so the explicit "RET/IPTAL ... yazip 1234" instruction (optOut) exempts a message from the stricter rules. It isn't a Promotions marker itself: OTP and card alerts also say "IPTAL yazip". "IYS" counts for Promotions only: betting spam copies it. The "B0xx" code at the end isn't a marker: delivery, card and OTP messages carry it too.

rules.name: Doğrulama kodları
rules.details: Doğrulama ve giriş kodları. Telefon numarasından gelenler gelen kutusunda kalır.

en.name: Verification codes
en.details: Verification and login codes. Messages from a phone number stay in the inbox.

rules.note: Discount codes look like OTPs ("indirim kodunuz: CS1202", "firsat kodu: 20020", "indirim icin sifreniz 0000"); a transaction beats a promotion, so they would leave Promotions. A code word right after indirim/firsat/kupon/kampanya/promosyon doesn't count, nor digits glued to letters.

rules.name: Kargo bilgilendirme
rules.details: "Kargoya verildi", "teslim edildi" bildirimleri. Telefon numarasından gelenler gelen kutusunda kalır.

en.name: Delivery updates
en.details: "Shipped" and "delivered" notifications. Messages from a phone number stay in the inbox.

rules.note: Companies send from a registered name; a phone number writing like a courier gets no Transactions trust (see phone-lure).

rules.name: Kart ve hesap hareketleri
rules.details: Kart harcaması ve hesap hareketi bildirimleri. Telefon numarasından gelenler gelen kutusunda kalır.

en.name: Card and account activity
en.details: Card spending and account activity notifications. Messages from a phone number stay in the inbox.

rules.name: Fatura ve ekstre
rules.details: Tutarı ve son ödeme tarihi yazan fatura ve kart ekstresi bildirimleri. Telefon numarasından gelenler gelen kutusunda kalır.

en.name: Bills and statements
en.details: Bill and card statement notices with an amount and a due date. Messages from a phone number stay in the inbox.

rules.note: Campaigns about bills ("otomatik fatura talimatina bonus", "son gun") name no due date; a real bill names one together with the amount.

rules.name: Randevu bildirimleri
rules.details: Oluşturulan, onaylanan, iptal edilen ve hatırlatılan randevular. Telefon numarasından gelenler gelen kutusunda kalır.

en.name: Appointments
en.details: Appointments that were booked, confirmed, cancelled or are coming up. Messages from a phone number stay in the inbox.

rules.note: Campaigns ask you to book ("randevu icin", "randevunuzu hemen alin"); only "your appointment" with a date, a time or a done verb counts.

rules.name: Ödeme onayları
rules.details: "Ödemeniz alınmıştır", "tahsil edilmiştir" gibi ödeme onayları. Telefon numarasından gelenler gelen kutusunda kalır.

en.name: Payment confirmations
en.details: Confirmations such as "your payment was received". Messages from a phone number stay in the inbox.

rules.note: Only finished verbs count, so scams saying the payment failed ("alinamamistir", "basarisiz", "onaylanmamistir") don't get in.
